17-13-0303-C(1) NARRATIVE ZONING ANALYSIS
SUBJECT PROPERTY: 970 WEST ALTGELD AVENUE, CHICAGO, ILLINOIS
ZONING: B2-3 NEIGHBORHOOD MIXED USE DISTRICT TYPE 1.
LOT AREA: 3,056 SQUARE FEET

LAND USE: THE PROPERTY IS CURRENTLY IMPROVED WITH A THREE-STORY AND

GARDEN LEVEL MULTI-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS CONSISTING OF TWO

DWELLING UNITS AND ZERO OFF-STREET PARKING SPACES. APPLICANT IS SEEKING TO

REZONE THE PROPERTY TO ALLOW UP TO THREE ADDITIONAL DWELLING UNITS ON THE

GROUND FLOOR AND GARDEN LEVEL OF THE PROPERTY. THE APPLICANT DOES NOT

PROPOSE TO MAKE ANY CHANGES TO THE ENVELOPE OF THE BUILDING.

(A) FLOOR AREA RATIO: 3.0 (EXISTING).

(B) MINIMUM LOT AREA PER UNIT: 611.2 SQUARE FEET.

(C) THE AMOUNT OF OFF-STREET PARKING: ZERO (EXISTING). APPLICANT IS SEEKING
A PARKING REDUCTION TO ZERO REQUIRED SPACES BECAUSE IT IS A TRANSIT
SERVED LOCATION. APPLICANT WILL COMPLY WITH SECTION 17-10-0102-B OF THE
CHICAGO ZONING ORDINANCE.

(D) SETBACKS:

1. FRONT SETBACK: 0 FEET, 0 INCHES (EXISTING).

2. REAR SETBACK: 0 FEET, 0 INCHES (EXISTING).

3. WEST SIDE SETBACK: 0 FEET, 0 INCHES (EXISTING).

4. EAST SIDE SETBACK: 0 FEET, 0 INCHES (EXISTING).

5: COMBINED SIDE YARD SETBACK: 0 FEET, 0 INCHES (EXISTING).

(E) BUILDING HEIGHT: 50 FEET, 0 INCHES (EXISTING),

THE APPLICANT WILL SEEK ALL ZONING RELIEF AS NECESSARY, AS ALLOWED BY
THE CHICAGO ZONING CODE, FOR THE ATTACHED PLANS.
